limitations: The audit recomputes statistics from saved predictions; it does not replay model inference or retrain models.
Hashes and internally consistent records establish agreement of supplied artifacts, not independent attestation of training execution.
Lexical/exact grouping checks do not rule out semantic paraphrases, translations, or pretraining contamination.
RQ3 and RQ4 have one training seed each; paired group intervals condition on fitted models and exclude training-seed uncertainty.
Input-only has one seed per architecture; exact 20% accuracy is a property of complete deterministic five-way pairing.
The length experiment conditions on K=256 eligibility; it cannot be generalized directly to excluded short responses.
The original automatically generated HTML remains a report scaffold with STUDENT placeholders; it is not a final submission.
Saved checkpoints were not deserialized in this audit.
